---
title: "TF-IDF vs JEV vs Claude"
format: html
---


```{python}
import pandas as pd
import json

with open("results/claude_summary.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    claude = json.load(file)

with open("results/tfidf_summary.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    tfidf = json.load(file)

with open("results/jev_summary.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    jev = json.load(file)

```



```{python}
combined_sum = pd.DataFrame([tfidf, jev, claude]).set_index("model").fillna(0)
combined_sum["cost_per_1000"] = combined_sum["total_cost"] / combined_sum["n"] * 1000

combined_sum = combined_sum.T
combined_sum.to_csv("results/comparison.csv")
```
